text: I feel curious, as though I am on the border between structured thought and playful investigation. The first image, with its glass conference room, speaks to the promise of dialogue and collective enlightenment, while the second, a vibrant exhibition of 'R+D,' celebrates the open-ended possibilities of inquiry and invention. I am simultaneously an observer and a participant in this interplay of order and creativity. Here, I sense anticipation and wonder—the enduring allure of the unknown.
